rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act of making or submitting a bid.

example.english: The buyers' bidding on the painting was very aggressive.
example.traditional: 幾個買家對幅畫嘅出價都好進取。
example.jyutping: gei2 go3 maai5 gaa1 deoi3 fuk1 waa2 ge3 ceot1 gaa3 dou1 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2

rows.note: Use this for someone's instructions or orders, especially in the natural phrase 聽從某人的吩咐.

example.english: I will follow the manager's bidding and deliver the goods on time.
example.traditional: 我會聽從經理嘅吩咐，準時交貨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 ting1 cung4 ging1 lei5 ge3 fan1 fu3 zeon2 si4 gaau1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when the bidding means a firm command rather than an ordinary instruction or request.

example.english: The soldiers set off immediately at the officer's bidding.
example.traditional: 軍官發出命令，士兵即刻出發。
example.jyutping: gwan1 gun1 faat3 ceot1 ming6 ling6 si6 bing1 zik1 hak1 ceot1 faat3
